About the Two Bikes Bike Party group ride

Themed monthly social ride from Knoxville's nonprofit bike shop. Four to eight miles at party pace, usually ending at a brewery or some other destination rather than back at the shop. Helmets required, locks recommended.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
